0022600187.text: The Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 2-1 on the road) enter this 8th game of their season on a two-game losing streak, 5th in the Southeast and 12th in the East, while the Suns (1-4) are on a three-game slide and sit 12th in the West. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Izaiyah Nelson, Jonathan Isaac, and Noah Penda, and Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams, and Rasheer Fleming. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have no games yet in 2026-27, and the Magic won the last meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
